bank.name: Scholars & Imams
bank.subject: Islamic Studies
bank.description: The great Imams of fiqh, hadith scholars and early Islamic personalities.

questions.prompt: Which Imam is known as the author of 'Al-Umm' and founded a school combining hadith and fiqh?
questions.explanation: Imam Muhammad ibn Idris al-Shafi'i wrote Al-Umm and founded the Shafi'i school.

questions.prompt: Who is the founder of the Hanbali school of thought?
questions.explanation: Imam Ahmad bin Hanbal founded the Hanbali school, known for its strict adherence to hadith.

questions.prompt: What are the 'Sihah Sittah'?
options: The six most authentic collections of hadith
questions.explanation: The Sihah Sittah are the six canonical hadith collections: Bukhari, Muslim, Abu Dawood, Tirmidhi, Nasa'i and Ibn Majah.

questions.prompt: Who is called the 'Sultan-ul-Hind' for his revival of Islam in South Asia?
questions.explanation: Sheikh Ahmad Sirhindi (Mujaddid Alf Thani) is known as Mujaddid (reviver) of the second millennium.

questions.prompt: Who wrote 'Hujjatullah al-Baligha' and translated the Quran into Persian?
questions.explanation: Shah Waliullah Dehlawi (1703-1762) wrote Hujjatullah al-Baligha and translated the Quran into Persian.

questions.prompt: Who was the first compiler of the hadith literature into a formal book?
questions.explanation: Imam Malik's Al-Muwatta (8th century) is regarded as one of the earliest formal compilations of hadith and fiqh.

questions.prompt: Which scholar compiled 'Fath al-Bari', the most famous commentary on Sahih al-Bukhari?
questions.explanation: Ibn Hajar al-Asqalani wrote Fath al-Bari, the celebrated commentary on Sahih al-Bukhari.

questions.prompt: Who wrote the famous Tafsir 'Ma'ariful Quran' in Urdu?
questions.explanation: Mufti Muhammad Shafi wrote Ma'ariful Quran, a widely used Urdu Tafsir.

questions.prompt: Who authored 'Tafhim-ul-Quran'?
questions.explanation: Maulana Abul A'la Maududi authored Tafhim-ul-Quran, a major Urdu commentary of the Quran.

questions.prompt: Who is known as the 'Father of Modern Islamic Economics' and wrote 'Islami Ma'ashiat'?
questions.explanation: Maulana Maududi wrote Islami Ma'ashiat (Islamic Economics) and is a pioneer of modern Islamic economics.

questions.prompt: Who is considered the founder of the 'Aligarh Movement' for Muslim education in India?
questions.explanation: Sir Syed Ahmad Khan founded the Aligarh Movement and Muhammadan Anglo-Oriental College (later AMU).

questions.prompt: Who wrote the famous book 'Al-Risala', the foundational work on the principles of Islamic jurisprudence?
questions.explanation: Imam al-Shafi'i's Al-Risala is the earliest systematic work on Usul al-Fiqh.

questions.prompt: Which female scholar narrated more than 2,000 hadiths and is called 'Umm al-Mu'minin'?
questions.explanation: Aisha (RA), the Prophet's wife, narrated over 2,000 hadiths and was a major source of Islamic knowledge.

questions.prompt: Who is called the 'Sheikh ul Islam' and wrote 'Tafsir Ibn Kathir'?
questions.explanation: Ismail ibn Kathir (d. 1373 CE) wrote the famous Tafsir al-Quran al-Azim (Tafsir Ibn Kathir).

questions.prompt: Which great scholar is known as 'Mujaddid-e-Alf-e-Sani' (Reviver of the Second Millennium)?
questions.explanation: Sheikh Ahmad Sirhindi is known as Mujaddid-e-Alf-e-Sani for his revivalist efforts in the 17th century.

questions.prompt: Who wrote 'Ihya Ulum al-Din' (The Revival of the Religious Sciences)?
questions.explanation: Imam Abu Hamid al-Ghazali (1058-1111) wrote Ihya Ulum al-Din, a masterpiece of Islamic spirituality.

questions.prompt: Who wrote the famous 'Sahih' collection and was a student of Imam Bukhari?
questions.explanation: Imam Muslim studied under Imam Bukhari and compiled Sahih Muslim.

questions.prompt: Who is known as the 'Hujjat-ul-Islam' (Proof of Islam)?
questions.explanation: Imam Abu Hamid al-Ghazali earned the title Hujjat-ul-Islam.

questions.prompt: Which scholar is known as the 'Mujaddid' (reviver) of the 12th Islamic century in the subcontinent?
questions.explanation: Shah Waliullah is often called the Mujaddid of his era for his revivalist work.

questions.prompt: Who wrote 'Al-Fiqh al-Akbar', a foundational text on Islamic creed?
questions.explanation: Al-Fiqh al-Akbar is attributed to Imam Abu Hanifa on matters of Aqeedah.

questions.prompt: Who was the founder of the Deobandi movement?
questions.explanation: Qasim Nanautawi and Rashid Ahmad Gangohi founded Darul Uloom Deoband in 1866.

questions.prompt: Who wrote 'Tafsir al-Jalalayn', a famous short commentary?
questions.explanation: Tafsir al-Jalalayn was co-authored by two Jalals — al-Mahalli and al-Suyuti.

questions.prompt: Who wrote 'Al-Jami' al-Sahih' and is buried in Nishapur?
questions.explanation: Imam Muslim is buried in Nishapur (Iran).

questions.prompt: Which scholar is famous for his 'Sunan' and for grading hadiths with 'Hasan'?
questions.explanation: Imam al-Tirmidhi pioneered the 'Hasan' (good) grading in his Jami.

questions.prompt: Who is the compiler of 'Sunan Ibn Majah', the last of the Sihah Sittah?
questions.explanation: Muhammad ibn Yazid Ibn Majah compiled the Sunan bearing his name.

questions.prompt: Who wrote 'Tafsir al-Qurtubi' (Al-Jami' li-Ahkam al-Quran), focused on rulings?
questions.explanation: Imam al-Qurtubi's Tafsir emphasizes legal rulings (Ahkam) from the Quran.

questions.prompt: Which companion is known as the 'Interpreter of the Quran' (Tarjuman-ul-Quran)?
questions.explanation: Abdullah ibn Abbas (RA) earned 'Tarjuman-ul-Quran' for his deep Quranic knowledge.

questions.prompt: Which of the ten promised Jannah was martyred at the Battle of Badr?
questions.explanation: Ubaidah ibn al-Harith, one of the Ashara Mubashshara, died of wounds from Badr.

questions.prompt: Who was the first to embrace Islam from the slaves?
questions.explanation: Bilal (RA), an Abyssinian slave, was among the earliest believers.

questions.prompt: Who wrote 'Risalat al-Tawhid' and influenced modern Islamic thought?
questions.explanation: Muhammad Abduh's Risalat al-Tawhid (1897) addressed theology and reform.

questions.prompt: Who founded the Muslim Brotherhood (Ikhwan al-Muslimun) in 1928?
questions.explanation: Hasan al-Banna founded the Muslim Brotherhood in Egypt in 1928.

questions.prompt: Who wrote 'Islami Nazariyat-e-Hayat' and 'Tafhim-ul-Quran'?
questions.explanation: Maududi authored both Tafhim-ul-Quran and Islami Nazariyat-e-Hayat.

questions.prompt: Who was the teacher of Imam Abu Hanifa in hadith?
questions.explanation: Abu Hanifa studied under the fifth Imam, Muhammad al-Baqir, among others.

questions.prompt: Which scholar compiled 'Sunan Abu Dawood', strong on legal rulings?
questions.explanation: Abu Dawood's Sunan is prized for fiqh-relevant hadiths.

questions.prompt: Who wrote 'Al-Muwatta' and is buried in Madinah?
questions.explanation: Imam Malik, author of Al-Muwatta, is buried in Al-Baqi, Madinah.

questions.prompt: Who is called the 'Shaykh al-Islam' of his time and authored 'Fatawa' that bear his name?
questions.explanation: Ibn Taymiyyah (1263-1328) is known as Shaykh al-Islam; his Fatawa remain influential.

questions.prompt: Which Imam is known as the 'Greatest Imam' (Imam al-Azam)?
questions.explanation: Imam Abu Hanifa is called Imam al-Azam.

questions.prompt: Which Imam wrote 'Al-Risala' on usul al-fiqh?
questions.explanation: Imam Shafi'i authored Al-Risala.

questions.prompt: Imam Malik was based in which city?
questions.explanation: Imam Malik lived in Madinah.

questions.prompt: Imam Ahmad bin Hanbal authored which famous hadith collection?
questions.explanation: Musnad Ahmad is his major work.

questions.prompt: The scholar Al-Ghazali is famous for which title?
questions.explanation: Al-Ghazali is Hujjat-ul-Islam.

questions.prompt: Ibn Taymiyyah was known for his expertise in:
questions.explanation: Ibn Taymiyyah excelled in Islamic sciences.

questions.prompt: Imam Nawawi is famous for which hadith collection?
questions.explanation: Riyad as-Salihin is Imam Nawawi's classic.

questions.prompt: The famous mufassir Al-Qurtubi wrote which Tafsir?
questions.explanation: Al-Qurtubi authored the Ahkam tafsir.

questions.prompt: Which scholar is known as 'the reviver of the second century'?
questions.explanation: Hadith mentions a reviver each century; Shafi'i is often linked to his era.

questions.prompt: Who was the famous student of Imam Abu Hanifa who compiled his rulings?
options: Imam Abu Yusuf and Imam Muhammad
questions.explanation: Abu Yusuf and Muhammad al-Shaybani recorded Hanafi fiqh.

questions.prompt: The scholar 'Imam al-Bukhari' was born in:
questions.explanation: Imam Bukhari was born in Bukhara.

questions.prompt: The 'Tafsir al-Tabari' was written by:
questions.explanation: Al-Tabari authored the great historical tafsir.

questions.prompt: The scholar 'Ibn Qayyim al-Jawziyyah' was the student of:
questions.explanation: Ibn Qayyim was Ibn Taymiyyah's foremost student.

questions.prompt: Which female scholar was among the teachers of Imam al-Bukhari?
options: None; Bukhari's teachers were all men
questions.explanation: Bukhari studied under male scholars; women scholars like Nafisa are known separately.

questions.prompt: The founder of the university Al-Azhar was from which dynasty?
questions.explanation: Al-Azhar was founded under the Fatimids in 970 CE.

questions.prompt: The scholar 'Shah Waliullah Dehlawi' was from:
questions.explanation: Shah Waliullah lived in Delhi.

questions.prompt: Which scholar translated the Quran into Persian?
questions.explanation: Shah Waliullah translated the Quran into Persian.

questions.prompt: The famous scholar 'Mawlana Rumi' wrote:
questions.explanation: Rumi's Mathnawi is a spiritual masterpiece.

questions.prompt: The scholar 'Imam al-Nasa'i' specialised in:
questions.explanation: Nasa'i was a hadith scholar.

questions.prompt: In which year was Darul Uloom Deoband founded?
questions.explanation: Darul Uloom Deoband was established in 1866.

questions.prompt: The Fatawa-e-Alamgiri, a major Hanafi legal code, was compiled under which Mughal emperor?
questions.explanation: Fatawa-e-Alamgiri was compiled by scholars on Aurangzeb's order.

questions.prompt: Who wrote the famous Tafsir 'Al-Kashshaf'?
questions.explanation: Al-Kashshaf was written by Abu al-Qasim al-Zamakhshari.

questions.prompt: The classical work 'Asbab al-Nuzul' (occasions of revelation) was compiled by?
questions.explanation: Al-Wahidi wrote the famous Asbab al-Nuzul.

questions.prompt: Who wrote the universal history 'Al-Kamil fi al-Tarikh'?
questions.explanation: Al-Kamil fi al-Tarikh is by Ali ibn al-Athir.

questions.prompt: Who wrote the 'Muqaddimah', the famous introduction to the philosophy of history?
questions.explanation: Ibn Khaldun's Muqaddimah founded the philosophy of history.

questions.prompt: Who wrote 'Al-Mustasfa', a major work on the principles of jurisprudence?
questions.explanation: Al-Mustasfa min 'Ilm al-Usul is by Imam al-Ghazali.

questions.prompt: The hadith collection 'Kanz al-Ummal' was compiled by?
questions.explanation: Kanz al-Ummal was compiled by Al-Muttaqi al-Hindi.

questions.prompt: The popular South Asian hadith work 'Mishkat al-Masabih' was compiled by?
questions.explanation: Mishkat al-Masabih is by Wali al-Din al-Tabrizi.

questions.prompt: Who compiled the hadith work 'Al-Adab al-Mufrad' on manners?
questions.explanation: Al-Adab al-Mufrad is a collection of hadith on manners by al-Bukhari.

questions.prompt: Who wrote the hadith collection 'Sunan al-Kubra'?
questions.explanation: Sunan al-Kubra is by Ahmad ibn al-Husayn al-Bayhaqi.

questions.prompt: Who authored the creedal text 'Al-Aqeedah al-Tahawiyyah'?
questions.explanation: Al-Aqeedah al-Tahawiyyah is by Abu Ja'far al-Tahawi.

questions.prompt: Who wrote 'Kitab al-Kharaj', a foundational work on public finance in Islam?
questions.explanation: Kitab al-Kharaj was written by Abu Yusuf, a student of Abu Hanifa.

questions.prompt: Who wrote 'Al-Hidayah', the classical manual of Hanafi fiqh?
questions.explanation: Al-Hidayah is by Burhan al-Din al-Marghinani.

questions.prompt: Who founded the Barelvi movement in South Asia?
questions.explanation: The Barelvi movement was founded by Ahmad Raza Khan Barelvi.

questions.prompt: Who wrote 'Kanzul Iman', a widely used Urdu translation of the Quran?
questions.explanation: Kanzul Iman is the Urdu translation by Ahmad Raza Khan Barelvi.

questions.prompt: Who wrote the famous Urdu Tafsir 'Tafsir-e-Usmani'?
questions.explanation: Tafsir-e-Usmani is by Maulana Shabbir Ahmad Usmani and his teachers.

questions.prompt: Who compiled the Shia hadith collection 'Bihar al-Anwar'?
questions.explanation: Bihar al-Anwar is the encyclopedic hadith work of Allama Majlisi.

questions.prompt: The sermons and sayings of Imam Ali (RA) collected in 'Nahj al-Balagha' were compiled by?
questions.explanation: Nahj al-Balagha was compiled by Sharif al-Radi.

questions.prompt: Who authored 'Al-Kafi', the most important Shia hadith collection?
questions.explanation: Al-Kafi is by Muhammad ibn Ya'qub al-Kulayni.

questions.prompt: Who wrote 'Al-Muwafaqat', the foundational work on the objectives of Shariah?
questions.explanation: Al-Muwafaqat on Maqasid al-Shariah is by Abu Ishaq al-Shatibi.

questions.prompt: Who wrote 'Al-Ashbah wa al-Naza'ir', a classic of Hanafi legal maxims?
questions.explanation: Al-Ashbah wa al-Naza'ir is by Jalal al-Din al-Suyuti.

questions.prompt: The modern Tafsir 'Al-Manar' was written jointly by?
questions.explanation: Tafsir al-Manar was begun by Abduh and completed by Rashid Rida.

questions.prompt: Who founded the Jamaat-e-Islami in 1941?
questions.explanation: Abul A'la Maududi founded the Jamaat-e-Islami in 1941.

questions.prompt: Who authored the 'Maktubat-i-Imam Rabbani' (the Letters of Imam Rabbani)?
questions.explanation: Maktubat-i-Imam Rabbani collects the letters of Ahmad Sirhindi.

questions.prompt: Who wrote 'The Reconstruction of Religious Thought in Islam'?
questions.explanation: Iqbal's Reconstruction lectures were published in 1930.

questions.prompt: Which poet-philosopher is known as 'Shair-e-Mashriq' (Poet of the East)?
questions.explanation: Allama Iqbal is honoured as the Poet of the East.

questions.prompt: Imam Shafi'i studied fiqh under which great Imam in Madinah?
questions.explanation: Imam Shafi'i was a student of Imam Malik in Madinah.

questions.prompt: The title 'Al-Muwatta' of Imam Malik literally means?
questions.explanation: Al-Muwatta means the well-trodden, approved path.

questions.prompt: Who wrote 'Radd al-Muhtar', the famous commentary on Al-Durr al-Mukhtar?
questions.explanation: Radd al-Muhtar, the great Hanafi reference, is by Ibn Abidin.

questions.prompt: Who wrote the Tafsir 'Fath al-Qadir' combining hadith and tafsir?
questions.explanation: Fath al-Qadir is the celebrated Tafsir of Muhammad al-Shawkani.

questions.prompt: Who wrote 'Zad al-Ma'ad', a comprehensive work on the Seerah and fiqh?
questions.explanation: Zad al-Ma'ad fi Hady Khayr al-'Ibad is by Ibn Qayyim.

questions.prompt: Which modern scholar is famous for grading hadiths in 'Silsilat al-Ahadith al-Sahihah'?
questions.explanation: Al-Albani is renowned for his hadith authentication work.

questions.prompt: Who wrote 'Fiqh al-Sunnah', a widely used modern fiqh manual?
questions.explanation: Fiqh al-Sunnah is by Sayyid Sabiq.

questions.prompt: Who wrote 'Al-Mughni', the great Hanbali encyclopedia of fiqh?
questions.explanation: Al-Mughni is the monumental Hanbali fiqh work of Ibn Qudamah.

questions.prompt: Who wrote 'Al-Muhalla', the Zahiri fiqh work arranged by rulings?
questions.explanation: Al-Muhalla is by the Zahiri scholar Ibn Hazm of Andalusia.

questions.prompt: Who compiled the authentic hadith collection known as 'Sahih Ibn Hibban'?
questions.explanation: Sahih Ibn Hibban is by the scholar Ibn Hibban al-Busti.

questions.prompt: Who compiled 'Al-Mustadrak ala al-Sahihain', supplementing Bukhari and Muslim?
questions.explanation: Al-Mustadrak is by Abu Abdillah al-Hakim al-Nishapuri.

questions.prompt: Who wrote the history 'Al-Bidayah wa al-Nihayah' (The Beginning and the End)?
questions.explanation: Al-Bidayah wa al-Nihayah is the universal history of Ibn Kathir.

questions.prompt: Who wrote the Tafsir 'Al-Mazhari', popular in South Asia?
questions.explanation: Tafsir al-Mazhari is by Qadi Thanaullah Panipati.

questions.prompt: Who edited and transmitted the 'Sirat Rasul Allah' as 'Al-Sirah al-Nabawiyyah'?
questions.explanation: Ibn Hisham edited Ibn Ishaq's Sirat into the famous recension.

questions.prompt: Who wrote 'Al-Tabaqat al-Kubra', the great biographical dictionary of early Muslims?
questions.explanation: Al-Tabaqat al-Kubra is by Ibn Sa'd, secretary of al-Waqidi.

questions.prompt: Who wrote 'Tarikh al-Rusul wa al-Muluk' (History of the Prophets and Kings)?
questions.explanation: The famous universal history is by Ibn Jarir al-Tabari.

questions.prompt: Who wrote 'Al-Itqan fi Ulum al-Quran', the classic on Quranic sciences?
questions.explanation: Al-Itqan fi Ulum al-Quran is by Jalal al-Din al-Suyuti.

questions.prompt: Who wrote 'Sharh al-Aqa'id al-Nasafiyyah' on theology?
questions.explanation: The celebrated commentary on the Nasafi creed is by al-Taftazani.
